patch.summary:
Choose Intercom only if your buying job matches “Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin from $0.9” rather than Zendesk Sell's shape. Choose Zendesk Sell only if your buying job matches “Zendesk Sell CRM; Team $19 through Enterprise $169/agent/mo annual.” rather than Intercom's shape. Workflow advantage: Intercom leans live-chat-support, customer-messaging; Zendesk Sell leans pipeline-management, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Intercom is Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin from $0.99/outcome. Primary live-chat; BC + CS secondary.; Zendesk Sell is Zendesk Sell CRM; Team $19 through Enterprise $169/agent/mo annual..
- Workflow coverage skew: Intercom-leaning live-chat-support, customer-messaging, whatsapp-support vs Zendesk Sell-leaning pipeline-management, lead-management, sales-automation.
- Researched limits: Intercom — Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume; Zendesk Sell — Sell is one product in a larger Zendesk stack — packaging can confuse.

Limitations — Intercom: Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume; SMS, WhatsApp and Phone are pay-as-you-go add-on channels, not unlimited included; Zendesk Sell: Sell is one product in a larger Zendesk stack — packaging can confuse; Higher tiers escalate quickly vs SMB CRMs.

Poor-fit cases: Intercom is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume · Zendesk Sell is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Sell is one product in a larger Zendesk stack — packaging can confuse · Avoid Intercom if you actually need Zendesk Sell's motion (Zendesk Sell CRM; Team $19 through Enterprise $169/agent/mo annual.)
